source_artifact.content_excerpt: Merges two absorbed ideation facets (T4-F3-6 primary, T4-F1-6 facet) from theme T4 (cache-aware prompt architecture) into one exploration: a one-shot residency A/B benchmark that proves or falsifies the worker-cache-scheduling cost claim, and a standing warm-reuse-benefit regression guard over the run ledger.

absorbed.title: Residency A/B benchmark: prove the recon fan-out cache claim before scaling the architecture
absorbed.basis: First-principles: residency only saves tokens if same-segment spawns actually achieve cache_read>0; no repo artifact measures the residency-ON vs residency-OFF delta, so the architecture's core premise is currently asserted, not checked, directly conflicting with this repo's stated Validation Discipline norm.

absorbed.title: Residency-benefit regression guard: prove the warm reuse actually cached
absorbed.basis: Grounding brief section 6.1: silent no-ops are the dominant failure class and any bridge/delegation idea needs did-it-actually-run/persist verification (agy silent Claude-fallback, dead-wiring learnings). Operationalizes the verified cache-hit check: if cache_read_input_tokens is zero across repeated identical-prefix requests, a silent invalidator is at work (claude-api shared/prompt-caching.md). Consumes the ledger from T4-F3-5 where available.

executor_profile.justification: Bounded measurement-and-guard engineering: one benchmark harness with a fixed fan-out shape and a documented verdict format, plus one ledger-based assertion with synthetic fixtures, with clear testable acceptance criteria and no architectural ambiguity.
